claims.claim: From high above, the forest appears as a continuous green roof, a closed canopy that traps moisture and shelters countless epiphytes and lianas.
claims.evidence: Rainforests are characterized by a closed and continuous tree canopy
claims.quote: Rainforests are characterized by a closed and continuous tree canopy

claims.claim: This living roof houses an estimated half of all terrestrial species, making rainforests the Earth's greatest pharmacy, where more than a quarter of natural medicines were first discovered.
claims.evidence: Estimates vary from 40% to 75% of all biotic species being indigenous to the rainforests
claims.quote: Estimates vary from 40% to 75% of all biotic species being indigenous to the rainforests

claims.claim: The Amazon rainforest, spanning over 670 million hectares, is the world's largest terrestrial carbon dioxide sink, capturing roughly 25% of global carbon dioxide.
In the dry season of 2019, satellite monitors recorded over 80,000 fires across Brazil, a 77 percent jump from the previous year, and thick smoke even dimmed distant cities.
claims.evidence: INPE reported more than 80,000 fires across all of Brazil, a 77% year-to-year increase
claims.quote: INPE reported more than 80,000 fires across all of Brazil, a 77% year-to-year increase

claims.claim: As the sun filters through layers of leaves, each drop of rain fuels a cycle that sustains climate and life, with rain providing water for hydroelectric power plants, crop irrigation, and suitable conditions for many types of ecosystems.
claims.evidence: Rain provides water for hydroelectric power plants, crop irrigation, and suitable conditions for many types of ecosystems
claims.quote: Rain provides water for hydroelectric power plants, crop irrigation, and suitable conditions for many types of ecosystems

claims.claim: Remember, the canopy is both a shield and a signal—protecting biodiversity while warning us of the fragile balance we must preserve.
